skill.name: extract-numbers-from-pdf
skill.description: Download PDF reports (annual reports, filings) and put the figures into a spreadsheet with the page number for each figure. Use when numbers must be pulled from several PDFs and be checkable.
skill.summary: Delegate PDF report collection and spreadsheet extraction to MyClawn, with source page numbers for checking figures.
skill.author: 20vision

security_audit.summary: The hardcoded URL is a descriptive reference, so the static finding is a false positive. No evidence found of prompt injection or unauthorized data transfer in SKILL.md. The workflow delegates work to an authenticated MyClawn connector, whose implementation is outside this review.

static_findings.snippet: Full description of this job, with the steps and the limits: https://www.myclawn.com/extract-numbers

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md:32 links to a task description on MyClawn; it does not instruct uploading documents, sending credentials, or executing remote content. The surrounding workflow uses an explicitly required connector, supporting a reference-link interpretation.

content.user_title: Extract PDF Report Figures With Source Pages
content.value_statement: Collecting figures from several PDF reports makes comparisons slow and source checking difficult. This skill delegates collection and spreadsheet preparation to MyClawn, requesting page references for each figure.
actual_capabilities: Frames a MyClawn task with the goal, source sites, output requirements, and prohibited actions.
Requests annual report downloads and a spreadsheet containing selected figures with their source page numbers.
Adapts the example companies and requested metrics to the user's task.
Delegates execution to the connector's task tool and waits for its result.
Relays the returned answer, final screenshot, and screen recording link.
Requires showing the final wording before sending tasks that submit forms, make bookings, or write to third parties.
limitations: Requires a signed-in MyClawn Computer connector; this skill contains instructions, not an independent PDF extraction engine.
References a separate cloud-computer-task skill for setup; that dependency is not included in the reviewed files.
Provides no extraction accuracy guarantee or specified OCR support; users must check figures against the source pages.
Users must complete sign-in and solve captchas themselves.

use_cases.title: Compare company results
use_cases.description: Request revenue, operating result, and headcount across companies for two years, with source pages for each figure.

use_cases.title: Collect research figures
use_cases.description: Gather selected numerical measures from public reports into a spreadsheet that preserves page references for verification.

use_cases.title: Prepare supplier comparisons
use_cases.description: Collect published financial and workforce figures for potential suppliers, using specified reports and page references.

prompt_templates.title: Extract one figure
prompt_templates.prompt: Use MyClawn to download [company]'s latest annual report from its official website. Put revenue and its source page number into a spreadsheet.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: collect one metric from one report.

prompt_templates.title: Compare two years
prompt_templates.prompt: Download [company]'s latest annual report. Extract revenue, operating result, and headcount for the last two reported years. Include each figure's year and source page number.
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: compare several metrics across two years.

prompt_templates.title: Compare several companies
prompt_templates.prompt: Use official investor websites to download the latest annual reports for [companies]. Create a spreadsheet comparing revenue, operating result, and headcount for [years]. Include company, year, metric, value, unit, report title, and source page. Mark missing figures instead of estimating.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: request a consistent comparison across multiple reports.

prompt_templates.title: Specify verification and boundaries
prompt_templates.prompt: Use MyClawn to collect [metrics] for [companies] and [years] from [approved sites]. Create a spreadsheet with source report titles, page numbers, units, and notes about differing definitions. Keep reported and calculated figures separate. Do not submit forms, create accounts, or write to third parties. Return the answer, final screenshot, and recording link.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: define source restrictions, comparison requirements, and action boundaries.

output_examples.input: Illustrative report excerpt: Example Company reported revenue of EUR 120 million for 2025 on page 18.
output_examples.output: Example spreadsheet row: Company: Example Company; Year: 2025; Metric: Revenue; Value: 120; Unit: EUR million; Source page: 18.

output_examples.input: Illustrative report excerpts: Example Company lists 850 employees for 2025 and 810 for 2024 on page 42.
output: Example spreadsheet row: Example Company; 2025; Headcount; 850 employees; Source page: 42.
Example spreadsheet row: Example Company; 2024; Headcount; 810 employees; Source page: 42.

best_practices: Specify companies, reporting years, metric definitions, and approved source sites before delegating the task.
Request units and source page numbers for every figure, then verify important values against the original reports.
State prohibited actions explicitly and review task wording before any form submission, booking, or third-party write.
anti_patterns: Relying on extracted figures without checking their source pages.
Comparing figures without checking currencies, units, reporting periods, and metric definitions.
Asking the connector to bypass captchas, create accounts, or act through third-party forms without user review.

faq.question: Does this skill extract PDFs locally?
faq.answer: No. It delegates the task to the user's signed-in MyClawn Computer connector.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: The MyClawn Computer connector must be signed in. The skill refers to cloud-computer-task for setup and leaves sign-in to the user.

faq.question: Can I choose different companies and metrics?
faq.answer: Yes. Replace the example companies and figures with your own, and specify the sources and desired output.

faq.question: How can I check the extracted figures?
faq.answer: The task requests a source page number for each figure. Check important figures directly against those pages.

faq.question: What does the workflow return?
faq.answer: It requests a spreadsheet and reports the connector's answer, final screenshot, and screen recording link.

faq.question: Does it guarantee scanned PDF support?
faq.answer: No. The instructions specify no OCR engine or scanned PDF guarantee. Extraction depends on the connector and document accessibility.
